title: Question 10
passage:
I thought Priya couldn't eat the cake we ordered.
A. She ordered a cake for her birthday last year. B. We changed the order after she told us about her allergy. C. I'm picking it up at four on my way home.
passageZh:
我以為 Priya 不能吃我們訂的蛋糕。
A. 她去年生日有訂蛋糕。
B. 她告訴我們她會過敏後，我們就改了訂單。
C. 我回家路上四點會去取蛋糕。
